verdict.rationale: 2FAS documents its own import feature for authenticator data from several named apps: Aegis, Raivo, LastPass, Stratum and Google Authenticator. That directly addresses migrating away from other authenticators. However, the evidence is a single support-page sentence. It does not state that imports bring in all tokens in one pass, and it gives no detail on formats or the import process. missing for 10: explicit documentation that imports are bulk (all tokens at once rather than per-account), details of supported import formats and workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration that imports work.

support.subject: As a power user, I can import tokens in bulk from other authenticator apps instead of re-enrolling every account by hand

citations.quote: We support imports from Aegis, Raivo, LastPassAegis, Stratum (formerly Authenticator Pro) and Google Authenticator.
